messages.解析Ⅲ以降は精神力を実質消費せずに撃てる、沈潜を付ける憂鬱打撃の広域E.G.O。: A multi-target Gloom Blunt E.G.O that inflicts Sinking and, from Threadspin Ⅲ, can be used at effectively no SP cost.
messages.精神力の回復(解析Ⅲ): 攻撃後に精神力を15回復する。精神消耗は15なので、使: **SP recovery (Threadspin Ⅲ)**: Restores 15 SP after the attack. Its Sanity cost is 15, so using it nets out to zero.
messages.広域と沈潜: 攻撃加重値3の広域で、Ⅰコインが的中時に沈潜を付与する(解析Ⅲで2: **Multi-target and Sinking**: A multi-target attack with 3 Attack Weight, and Coin Ⅰ inflicts Sinking on hit (from 2 to 5 at Threadspin Ⅲ). It is a single Coin with 11 Base Power and +10 Coin Power, so its power stays low on Tails.
messages.パッシブ「波紋」: ターン開始時、精神力が最も低い味方を、パネル上で最も多い自分: **Passive — Ripple**: At Turn Start, heals the ally with the lowest SP by his highest Absolute Resonance on the panel (except while panicking). Without Absolute Resonance, it heals nothing.
messages.必要資源: 憂鬱5・色欲1と憂鬱に偏る。侵蝕スキルは無い。: **Requirements**: 5 Gloom and 1 Lust, heavily skewed toward Gloom. It has no Corrosion skill.
messages.憂鬱の資源を出せる編成で、精神力を減らさずに沈潜を広く撒きたいときに使う。: Use it in teams that can supply Gloom when you want to spread Sinking widely without losing SP.
messages.完全共鳴を作りやすい編成なら、長期戦の序盤に撃って波紋を有効にしておく。: In teams that build Absolute Resonance easily, fire it early in a long fight to activate Ripple.
messages.マッチの切り札にするには威力が心もとないと考えられるので、通常スキルの補助として: Its power is likely too unreliable to be a Clash trump card, so use it to supplement regular skills.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が11から15、沈潜が2から5になり、攻撃後の精神力回復が付く。実: **Ⅲ**: Base Power goes from 11 to 15, Sinking from 2 to 5, and SP recovery after the attack is added. Its practical performance is decided here.
messages.Ⅳ: 次のターンに味方全員の精神力減少効率-2とE.G.O使用時の精神力減少-2: **Ⅳ**: Only adds −2 SP Loss Efficiency for all allies next turn and −2 SP loss when using E.G.O. Likely a low priority.
messages.南部リウ協会5課: S1(憂鬱)とS2(色欲)で必要資源をそのまま出せ、S1は精: **[Liu Assoc. South Section 5](persona:0604)**: S1 (Gloom) and S2 (Lust) supply the required affinities directly, and S1 also restores SP.
messages.南部ディエーチ協会4課: S2(憂鬱)が沈潜を付与し、S3も沈潜回数を増やすので: **[Dieci Assoc. South Section 4](persona:0608)**: S2 (Gloom) inflicts Sinking and S3 increases Sinking Count, so he comfortably covers a Sinking team's Gloom needs.
